item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Development and application of integrated digital models for the assessment of quality of life and clinical-functional outcomes in patients undergoing maxillofacial surgery. (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-28 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Milano
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-15 Neurochirurgia e chirurgia maxillo-facciale

This project builds upon activities initiated under the BD4QoL project, which aimed to develop digital tools for collecting, integrating, and analyzing clinical data and patient-reported outcomes for patients undergoing head and neck surgery. Drawing on that experience, the project seeks to broaden the scope of quality-of-life and clinical-functional outcome assessment models, extending them to the wider fields of cervicofacial and maxillofacial surgery.
